title: AI-Powered High-Precision Weather Forecasting Model
summary: Alibaba DAMO Academy reports that its Baguan weather model had 57.8% lower regional forecast error on average than ECMWF-IFS, the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts' system.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Alibaba's news site, Alizila, reported on 6 November 2024 that Baguan forecast a 20% drop in electricity demand in Shandong with 98.1% load-forecast accuracy. The article gives no date for the forecast and no measure of grid savings. The makers' paper, posted on 20 May 2025, reports a test on the last half of 2023 against the Integrated Forecasting System of the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF-IFS). In that test, Baguan-Regional achieved an average improvement of 57.8% on key regional variables. The paper states that the system serves the power sector in an eastern Chinese province. The Baguan submission to the International Telecommunication Union, current as of June 2025, reports improvements over ECMWF-IFS on selected forecast variables in regional and global comparisons. It names State Grid Shandong among the test settings. A version of the paper appeared in the proceedings of the 31st ACM SIGKDD Conference on 3 August 2025. Better forecasting of renewable power and better grid operations are intended applications. No source quantifies a resulting change in dispatch, reliability or emissions.
purpose: Improve weather forecasts for power, agriculture, and other weather-sensitive uses.
model_version: Baguan-Regional (regional fine-tune of the Baguan foundation model, KDD 2025 paper)
deployer: State Grid Shandong Electric Power Co., Ltd. (test setting)

ratings.reason: The makers report that Baguan-Regional cut regional forecast error by 57.8% on average compared with ECMWF-IFS, and they add global comparisons. No source measures a resulting improvement in grid operations.
Greater uptake of renewable energy and climate benefits are expected downstream effects that no source reports.

ai_role.statement: The makers compare Baguan's forecasts with ECMWF-IFS forecasts and with simple interpolation of Baguan's global forecasts on the same held-out data, so the reported error reductions measure what the model adds to forecast accuracy. No source separates any effect of the forecasts on grid operations from the work of the grid company.

evidence.title: Use Case 2: AI-Powered High-Precision Weather Forecasting Model
evidence.quote: In terms of the global model alone, it consistently outperforms IFS, achieving an average improvement of 20.5%.

evidence.citation: Peisong Niu, Ziqing Ma, Tian Zhou, Weiqi Chen, Lefei Shen, Rong Jin and Liang Sun, Utilizing Strategic Pre-training to Reduce Overfitting: Baguan - A Pre-trained Weather Forecasting Model, arXiv 2505.13873, 20 May 2025; a version appeared in the Proceedings of the 31st ACM SIGKDD Conference on 3 August 2025 (doi 10.1145/3711896.3737178). Six of the seven authors work at Alibaba's DAMO Academy, which built Baguan; the paper reports retrospective test results against ECMWF-IFS and states that the system was deployed for the power sector in an eastern Chinese province.
evidence.title: Utilizing Strategic Pre-training to Reduce Overfitting: Baguan -- A Pre-trained Weather Forecasting Model
evidence.quote: Baguan-Regional demonstrates significantly superior performance compared to EC-IFS, achieving an average improvement of 57.8% on key variables in regional forecasting.

evidence.citation: Crystal Liu, Alibaba's New AI Model Enhances Weather Forecasting Precision Amid Rising Climate Threats, Alizila, 6 November 2024. Alizila is Alibaba's own news site; the article announces Baguan and reports a load forecast in Shandong without method or date.
evidence.title: Alibaba's New AI Model Enhances Weather Forecasting Precision Amid Rising Climate Threats
evidence.quote: The model's precision was demonstrated during a sudden temperature drop in Shandong Province in China, where Baguan accurately anticipated a 20% drop in electricity demand, achieving a high accuracy-98.1% in load forecasting.

evidence.citation: Xinhua, 达摩院发布八观气象大模型：精度达1小时1公里，率先落地新能源场景 (DAMO Academy releases the Baguan weather model, with a precision of 1 hour and 1 kilometer, first in use for renewable energy), news.cn, 6 November 2024. DAMO Academy supplied this account of the launch, which China Daily's site also ran as promotional content. DAMO quotes State Grid Shandong's dispatch center on a load forecast from 25 to 28 August 2024.
evidence.title: 达摩院发布八观气象大模型：精度达1小时1公里，率先落地新能源场景
evidence.quote: 据国网山东省电力公司电力调度控制中心介绍，今年8月25日至8月28日，受降水影响，山东省气温出现大幅度变化，3日内用电负荷总量下降20%，八观气象大模型通过构筑每小时更新一次的高精度区域天气预报网络，及时捕捉到温度变化，推动下游新能源发电功率、电力负荷预测准确率分别提升至96.5%和98.1%

display.answer: Every cited source comes from Alibaba, which built Baguan. Six of the seven authors of the makers' paper of 20 May 2025 work at Alibaba's DAMO Academy. The submission to the International Telecommunication Union, current as of June 2025, is the makers' own account. The article of 6 November 2024 appeared on Alizila, Alibaba's own news site.
The geopolitical implications are unclear.

fields.summary: Alibaba DAMO Academy reports that its Baguan weather model had 57.8% lower regional forecast error on average than ECMWF-IFS, the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts' system.
fields.account: Alibaba's news site, Alizila, reported on 6 November 2024 that Baguan forecast a 20% drop in electricity demand in Shandong with 98.1% load-forecast accuracy. The article gives no date for the forecast and no measure of grid savings. The makers' paper, posted on 20 May 2025, reports a test on the last half of 2023 against the Integrated Forecasting System of the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF-IFS). In that test, Baguan-Regional achieved an average improvement of 57.8% on key regional variables. The paper states that the system serves the power sector in an eastern Chinese province. The Baguan submission to the International Telecommunication Union, current as of June 2025, reports improvements over ECMWF-IFS on selected forecast variables in regional and global comparisons. It names State Grid Shandong among the test settings. A version of the paper appeared in the proceedings of the 31st ACM SIGKDD Conference on 3 August 2025. Better forecasting of renewable power and better grid operations are intended applications. No source quantifies a resulting change in dispatch, reliability or emissions.
